items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: his son, Emel Washburn, he just loved me.

ctx.x: I'll get the other fella's name, he was a ladies man from Taw, he was a handsome fellow, a leading man. And Billy DeWolf looks down at the pit and he tells that huge audience, I felt like a millionaire. He says it is certainly a pleasure to see Johnny Dread back in the pit. He missed me so much. Because his motions and his actions were strictly more of them. You know he's an old timer. They call him Mr. Billy DeWolf now. Well I mean all that makes you feel good. Like I can recite that writer where the man says,…
I was wondering about your records and Russ Papalia. He played trouble with me on the records.
